title: Habakkuk Complains About Injustice and Receives God's Answer
description: The prophet Habakkuk complains to the Lord about the widespread violence and injustice in Judah, asking why God tolerates the law being paralyzed and the wicked surrounding the righteous. God answers by revealing that He is raising up the Chaldeans—the bitter and impetuous nation—as an instrument to punish His people. This leads to a new complaint from the prophet: how can a holy God, whose eyes are too pure to look on evil, use an even more wicked nation that makes its own strength its god?
